articles.description: — Walk-on freshman Weston Schofield kicked a 31-yard field goal as time expired to give Southern Illinois a 20-17 win over Northern Iowa on Saturday.

articles.headline: Weaver, Smith lead Monmouth to easy win over Hampton 49-13
articles.description: — Frankie Weaver threw three touchdown passes and four different backs ran for scores as Monmouth overwhelmed Hampton 49-13 on Saturday.

articles.headline: Richmond rides another solid defensive outing to 13-6 sacking of Colgate
articles.description: — Devin Geronomi had 11 solo tackles, Richmond recorded eight sacks, and the Spiders defeated Colgate 13-6 on Saturday.

articles.headline: Anderson accounts for 5 TDs, leads undefeated Tarleton State to 49-6 win over West Georgia
articles.description: — Kaden Anderson threw four touchdown passes and ran for another to lead undefeated Tarleton State to a 49-6 victory over West Georgia on Saturday.
